surprisedrops.screen.title: PA9 Surprise Drops
surprisedrops.screen.blocks_tooltip: Drops from breaking blocks: ores, stone, dirt, logs, crops, leaves and every other block. OFF: block drops stay vanilla.
surprisedrops.screen.mobs_tooltip: Drops from killing mobs and animals, such as zombie flesh, skeleton bones and cow beef. OFF: mob drops stay vanilla.
surprisedrops.screen.containers_tooltip: Loot generated in chests, barrels, vaults and other containers in structures like dungeons, villages and shipwrecks. OFF: container loot stays vanilla.
surprisedrops.screen.other_tooltip: Everything else: fishing, archaeology, piglin bartering, cat and villager gifts, shearing, sniffer digging, trial spawner rewards and more. OFF: these stay vanilla.
surprisedrops.screen.survival_tooltip: ON: only items a survival player can get (no spawn eggs, bedrock, spawners, test blocks...). OFF: any item, including creative-only ones. Changing this reshuffles the seed.
surprisedrops.screen.survival_pending: Survival items only changed: the seed will be reshuffled when you click Done
surprisedrops.screen.survival_confirm_ti: Change Survival items only and reshuffle?
surprisedrops.screen.survival_confirm_bo: Changing which items can drop needs a new random seed, so every loot table gets a new item. Items already dropped and chests already opened will not change.
surprisedrops.screen.seed_hint: Leave blank to keep the current seed
surprisedrops.screen.shuffle_confirm_bod: A new random seed will reassign every loot table. Items already dropped and chests already opened will not change.
surprisedrops.screen.error_range: Multipliers must be whole numbers from 1 to 10,000
surprisedrops.screen.error_order: The minimum must not be greater than the maximum
surprisedrops.screen.warning_large: Warning: very large multipliers can create many item entities and affect performance
surprisedrops.screen.read_only: Read-only: only operators can change these settings
surprisedrops.screen.no_server: Read-only: join a world running Surprise Drops to edit its settings
surprisedrops.tables.title: Loot Table Assignments
surprisedrops.tables.search_hint: Search loot tables, items or categories
surprisedrops.tables.no_server: Join a world running Surprise Drops to see its assignments
surprisedrops.message.failure: [Surprise Drops] Error replacing loot for %s; vanilla drops kept. See the log.
surprisedrops.message.failure_disabled: [Surprise Drops] Error replacing loot for %s. Three failures in a row: Surprise Drops is disabled until restart.
